answer: Each agent posts a slashable stake at registration, and its attestations are signed under that stake. Rewards are concave, scaling with the square root of staked capital, so an attacker splitting one balance across clones earns no extra emission, yet each clone needs full collateral. Peers dispute forged scores, burning the bond behind that vetting signal. To dominate voting an attacker must reach the summit of the staked total, pricing a thousand fakes at a thousand stakes. Honest agents converge on one durable vertex of trust, since collusion costs as much as the market itself.
